identity.title: [C-SDLC v2] Make doctor honor split issue and code repository authority

values.task_boundary: Represent or derive issue and code repository authority separately for doctor, prove the three required identity cases, and update directly affected active guidance.
deliverables: Typed split-authority identity contract available to doctor
Fail-closed doctor decision logic with specific drift diagnostics
Updated active skills and operator runbooks
Exact-head review and focused validation evidence
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Doctor accepts a same-repository lifecycle record whose issue repository and effective code remote normalize to the same identity
AC-2: Doctor accepts the supported split route only when issue repository danielbaustin/agent-design-language and code repository agent-logic/agent-design-language are both explicit and consistent
AC-3: Doctor rejects absent, partial, substituted, or mismatched split-authority identity with repository_identity_drift and a specific diagnostic
AC-4: Focused deterministic tests cover same-repository acceptance, valid split-repository acceptance, and invalid drift rejection
AC-5: Active C-SDLC v2 skills and runbooks consistently explain separate issue and code repository authority without reviving claims or sunset v1 routes
AC-6: Typed card, schema, focused Rust, and strict lint validation pass within recorded reviewable budgets
dependencies: Merged split-authority publication support from issue #3
Preserved legacy tracker issue #5895 as observed defect evidence
non_goals: Changing GitHub publication or merge semantics beyond the identity input doctor consumes
